# BXLACK

> BXLACK is an Indian luxury streetwear label. It makes numbered, small-batch, all-black clothing: oversized T-shirts, shirts and jeans. Tagline: "Born To Stand Apart". Brand idea: "Absence of noise."

Prices are in Indian rupees (INR). Orders ship from India, with cash on delivery available for Indian addresses. Each piece is produced in a limited, numbered run.

## Shop
